title: Risk
description: One entry of the venture's risk register (ISO 31000:2018 clauses 6.4 to 6.6: risk assessment, risk treatment, monitoring and review), at legal/risks/<id>.json (route legal/risks/[id]): what could happen, why, what it would cost, who owns it and what the venture does about it. Likelihood and impact are 90% ranges, not ordinal scores (Hubbard, The Failure of Risk Management; Cox 2008), so expected loss can be computed and compared. Every live risk has a person owner and a review date. The risk-and-compliance function owns it, and only the risk-and-compliance agent (role risk-and-compliance-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json).

id.description: The risk's id, the file name without .json

title.description: The event, in a short sentence

consequence.description: What it would do to the venture

owner.description: The person who owns the risk's treatment, by people record id or role

likelihood.description: The chance it happens in the next 12 months, as a 90% range of probabilities

impact.description: What it would cost if it happens, as a 90% range

treatment.description: The ISO 31000 6.5 options in short: avoid (stop the activity), reduce (add a control), transfer (insurance or a contract), accept (live with it, with a reason)

treatment_plan.description: What the venture does, and the handoff or decision that carries it

review_date.description: When the owner next reviews it

related.description: Routes of records the risk concerns, such as an obligation or a lease
